releaseNotes: Major v2.0.0 CapCut-style Studio Update: 4-Pane Dark Video Editor with Multi-Track Magnetic Timeline (Main Video, Overlay/PIP, Text, Audio), Split (Cmd+B), Trim, Undo/Redo, Speed (0.25x-4x), Color Grading & 7 Filter Presets, Transitions, Text Overlays, Saved Recent Projects, and 720p-4K H.264/HEVC Export — alongside Collage Studio.
